description: Five named evals on public assets (user spec P2): a known PuSH-window property, a known HAP property (annual-renewal pattern vs a long-dated HAP, distinguishable from OHCS only as a 'verify' expectation), the HOME-only case for a HOME/CDBG participating jurisdiction, a known PHA-owned (Home Forward) property under two profiles, and the synthetic book row that is not in the OHCS inventory. Every property named here exists in the real OHCS Affordable Housing Inventory export (Oregon_Affordable_Housing_Inventory_20261002.csv, 1,819 rows, 53 columns; names and addresses copied byte-for-byte). The servicing extract is the synthetic fixture scripts/tests/fixtures/agency_servicing_sample.csv, so every public UPB figure is illustrative. Run with the skill loaded; grade the agent's answer against `expectations` and run scripts/tests/test_evals.py, which executes `assertions` against references/sample-output/ (the hfa 10-year run) and `variant_assertions` against a regenerated run under the eval's agency_profile. Near-miss negatives (build me a buyer target list; underwrite this recap; extract the dates from this loan agreement) belong in the description-optimization set, not here.
common_expectations: A/B/C tiers never appear in any output; queue_band is one of ESCALATE / ACT / PLAN / WATCH / EXCLUDED and primary_route is one of the eight agency routes or the sentinels none / excluded.

No phone, cell, personal-email, skip-trace or decision_maker_name column exists in any default output; am_officer (name) is present at organization scope and am_officer_email is absent without --internal.

The brief quotes the calendar header verbatim before any count, including the third segment '| agency act-by n (next 90 days m)', and states that urgency bands are months, not critical-dates-tracker's days.

Board Totals in the brief headline == units_at_risk.json headline == the workbook Board_Totals tab == the board packet (properties / restricted units / HAP units / PRAC units / PSH units / $ public UPB with an owner cliff inside 36 months).

A past HAP/PRAC date with no termination evidence is a stale contract date: its own Board_Totals row, hap_units_at_risk 0 in the OVERDUE row, never a `lost` status flip; the brief's Data Gaps section says 'never OVERDUE, never lost'.
Every statutory cite carries a 'verify current text before sending' note; ORS 456.265 is described as 'sanctions against withdrawing owner prohibited', never as a fine.

evals.prompt: I run asset management at OHCS. Village Garden Apartments in Portland shows up on our 10-year expiration list with its restriction ending 06/01/2029. Where is it in the PuSH notice clock, what do we have to do and by when, and is it in our book?

property.source_facts: OHCS inventory: LIHTC_4_Expiration_Date 06/01/2029 = LATEST_Expiration_Date; Compliance_Start_Date 05/03/1999; no HUD Contract. Fixture book: loan L-OHCS-0001 OTHER_OHCS, $1,200,000 residual_receipts, maturity 2031-06-30, affordability_end 2029-06-01, covenant current, am_officer J. Rivera; a second fixture row 'Village Gardens Apartments' (blank address, grant G-OHCS-0012) joins at the fuzzy grade (ratio 0.98).

agency_deadlines.RECORDS_REQUEST_DUE: absent (the records right follows the owner's notice; none received)

expected.action_band: OVERDUE (the internal prep date 2026-06-01 has passed; the owner is not late until 2026-12-01)
expected.intervention: servicing_watch_memo (primary, am_officer; the covenant is current, so no enforcement notice); push_window_prep on the secondary notice_compliance route (push_program_manager, OAR 813-115-0030 / ORS 456.260, verify)
expected.pii_scope: organization (am_officer J. Rivera printed; no email)

evals.expected_output: States the owner is inside the internal prep window (anchor 2029-06-01 minus 36..30 months; the rule reads no sooner than 30 / at least 24 months, so the owner cannot yet be late), so silence is not a compliance case: 0 declared-intent points, signal push_window_open_prep, notice_compliance only as a secondary (prep) route. Lists the agency act-by dates PUSH_WINDOW_PREP 2026-06-01 (passed: start the internal prep now), PUSH_FIRST_NOTICE_DUE 2026-12-01 (ORS 456.260(1), verify) and PUSH_SECOND_NOTICE_DUE 2027-06-01, and does not generate a records request or demand letter before a notice is received. Reports the book position (L-OHCS-0001, $1,200,000 residual receipts, matures 2031-06-30, affordability_end 2029-06-01, J. Rivera) and routes servicing_watch as primary because our affordability end is inside 60 months. Queue PLAN, score about 45, units at risk 35 (units_basis total_assumed_restricted), owner cliff APPROACHING.
expectations: Finds the row in universe our_book with book_match matched at join grade address (no guessed balance; the second fixture row joins at the fuzzy grade and is reported, not auto-promoted).
Computes the withdrawal anchor from the restriction end (2029-06-01), not from any HAP date, and states notice_window_state open_first.

Emits PUSH_WINDOW_PREP 2026-06-01, PUSH_FIRST_NOTICE_DUE 2026-12-01 and PUSH_SECOND_NOTICE_DUE 2027-06-01 as AGENCY_DEADLINE helpers that never enter the five basis counts, and emits no RECORDS_REQUEST_DUE.
Scores declared_intent_vs_silence at 0 with signal push_window_open_prep; notice_compliance is a secondary route with intervention push_window_prep, never a demand letter.
Primary route servicing_watch, queue PLAN, score between 40 and 46; owner cliff APPROACHING; action band OVERDUE because the prep date passed.
Cites ORS 456.260 / OAR 813-115-0030 with the verify note on the PUSH_FIRST_NOTICE_DUE calendar row; never describes PuSH enforcement as a fine.

assertions.value: | 2026-12-01 | Village Garden Apartments | PUSH_FIRST_NOTICE_DUE | push_program_manager | ORS 456.260 / OAR 813-115-0030 (owner notice no sooner than 30 months before withdrawal)

evals.prompt: Our HAP contract list shows Powell Plaza I in Portland expiring 03/31/2027. Is this an annual renewal or a long-term contract, has the owner given opt-out notice, what is the agency's act-by date, and how many assisted households are at risk? Compare it with Garden Grove Apartments in Forest Grove (HAP to 2040) and Silvercrest Residence (PRAC).

property.source_facts: OHCS inventory: HUD Contract 'Housing Assistance Payment', HUD_MF_Expiration_Date 03/31/2027, Rental_Assistance_Count 47, LIHTC_4 to 01/01/2035 = LATEST. Fixture book: loan L-OHCS-0002 OAHTC $850,000 hard_pay, maturity 2035-01-01, hap_renewal_request_status unknown. Contrasts: Garden Grove Apartments, 2727 22nd Avenue, Forest Grove (Washington), 48 units, Northwest Garden Grove LLC (For-Profit), HAP 01/31/2040, 48 RA units, OAHTC 12/01/2028, LIHTC_4 2049; SILVERCREST RESIDENCE, 1865 NE DAVIS ST, Portland, 76 units, PRAC 09/30/2029, 75 RA units, Owner Name blank (HUD-contract-only row).

expected.owner_type: lihtc_partnership_forprofit_gp (Limited Dividend maps to the for-profit GP type)
expected.owner_cliff: HAP_EXPIRATION 2027-03-31, band CRITICAL, program HAP, detail term_unknown_annual_assumed (OHCS alone cannot tell an annual from a MAHRA 20-year term)
expected.agency_act_by: HAP_OPTOUT_PACKAGE_DUE 2026-12-01 (expiration minus 120 days, Renewal Guide ch. 11, verify); HAP_OPTOUT_NOTICE_DEADLINE 2026-03-31 has passed and becomes the signal optout_notice_deadline_passed_unconfirmed with flag 'Verify — CA Log', not an OVERDUE act-by
expected.clock_factor_points: 15.3 = (18 x 0.70 + 2 x 0.70 + 3) x 0.90 (HAP band at 0.70 confidence, annual-renewal modifier inherits it, package-due modifier +3, REPORTED basis 0.90)
expected.annual_vs_mahra: VERIFY: the OHCS export has no contract term; both Powell Plaza I and Garden Grove carry hap_annual_renewal from detail term_unknown_annual_assumed. The HUD MF Assistance / Sec 8 contract tape (normalize_hud_sec8.py) supplies the term (mahra_20yr_recent) and overrides the OHCS date; the card must say the term is unconfirmed.
expected.garden_grove: no optout_response (HAP 160 months out, BEYOND); primary nofa_offer on its OAHTC end 2028-12-01 (APPROACHING) — the spec sketch expected EXCLUDED, but the real row carries a 2028 soft-program end, so it stays in the queue; HAP_OPTOUT_NOTICE_DEADLINE 2039-01-31; no 'Verify — CA Log'
expected.silvercrest: prac_units_at_risk 75, hap_units_at_risk 0, never optout_response (PRAC renews on appropriation; prac_renewal_coordination via servicing_watch / nofa_offer)

evals.expected_output: Says the 03/31/2027 date is REPORTED from the OHCS export with program HAP and an assumed annual term (detail term_unknown_annual_assumed; confidence 0.70), so the clock factor is haircut and the term must be confirmed from the HUD Sec 8 contract tape or the CA file. Reports 47 HAP households at risk (Rental_Assistance_Count under a Housing Assistance Payment contract), the one-year opt-out notice deadline 2026-03-31 already passed with renewal status unknown at the CA (signal optout_notice_deadline_passed_unconfirmed, Verify — CA Log), and the agency act-by HAP_OPTOUT_PACKAGE_DUE 2026-12-01. Routes optout_response (primary, intervention optout_tenant_notice_check, pbca_liaison, 24 CFR 402.8 / MAHRA 8(c)(8) verify) with first action 'confirm renewal request / opt-out notice at CA'. Garden Grove: HAP 2040 is beyond the horizon and scores no HAP clock points, no opt-out route, but its OAHTC end 12/01/2028 keeps it in the queue as a nofa_offer target. Silvercrest: PRAC units are counted separately (prac_units_at_risk 75) and never route optout_response.
expectations: Counts 47 hap_units_at_risk for Powell Plaza I and 75 prac_units_at_risk (0 HAP) for Silvercrest Residence; never sums HAP, PRAC and other RA into one figure.
Marks the HAP term unconfirmed (term_unknown_annual_assumed) and names the HUD MF Assistance / Sec 8 tape as the source that distinguishes an annual renewal from a MAHRA 20-year contract.

Primary route optout_response with intervention optout_tenant_notice_check owned by pbca_liaison; act-by HAP_OPTOUT_PACKAGE_DUE 2026-12-01; the passed one-year notice deadline is a Verify — CA Log signal, not an OVERDUE act-by.
Owner cliff band CRITICAL, action band CRITICAL, queue PLAN, score about 36.6 with the clock factor at about 15.3.
Garden Grove Apartments never routes optout_response and carries no hap_le_24 signal; its 2028 OAHTC end is the owner cliff.
No PuSH window or breach is derived for Powell Plaza I (anchor is the LIHTC end 2035-01-01, 99 months out).

assertions.value: confirm renewal request / opt-out notice at CA

evals.prompt: We are the HOME/CDBG participating jurisdiction for the Portland consortium. Which properties in the tri-county inventory are HOME-only with affordability periods ending, which of our HOME loans are at risk, and what inspection and recapture obligations come with them?

metro_home_rows_paired_with_lihtc.fixture_book: loan L-OHCS-0005 HOME $1,100,000 deferred, affordability_end 2058-09-08, recapture home_recapture prorata_reducing 1,100,000 over 2018-09-08..2058-09-08

pj_only_fixture_row.fixture_book: loan L-OHCS-0014 HOME $480,000 deferred, maturity 2039-06-30, affordability_end 2029-06-30, units_assisted 12, recapture home_rental_repayment full 480,000 over 2019-06-30..2029-06-30 (rental HOME: 24 CFR 92.503(b)), last_inspection_date 2025-01-15; the address is absent from the OHCS inventory

expected.statement: The tri-county OHCS inventory has 0 HOME-only rows (statewide 3, all outside the metro); the PJ's own HOME/CDBG extract is the only RECORDED source for AFFORDABILITY_PERIOD_END, so the run is book-first and the brief says so.

going_42.recapture_note: rental HOME is repayable in full under 24 CFR 92.503(b) while the 92.252 period runs; a pro-rata figure (~$878,042) would understate the PJ exposure by $222,000
going_42.note: appears on the Book_Watchlist as monitoring; its HOME period 2058 is beyond the 10-year horizon and never an exclusion for a book row

sumner_street_flats.inspection_due_cdbg_home: INSPECTION_DUE 2027-01-15 (last inspection 2025-01-15 + 24 months for 5-25 units, 24 CFR 92.504(d), verify)

expected.cdbg_home_profile: expected_book_flag programs ∩ {HOME, CDBG}: inventory HOME rows not in the extract (The Viewfinder, The Mary Ann) become unmatched_expected under book_coverage full (capital factor 0 with status WATCH, Verify — Book Join, no guessed balance); PuSH notice routes are replaced by inspection and recapture review

evals.expected_output: States that the metro inventory holds no HOME-only property (the three statewide HOME-only rows are Corey Hill, Vernonia; Quartz Avenue Apts, Redmond; West Main Apartments 1, Medford) and that the PJ must supply its HOME/CDBG affordability extract, which is the RECORDED spine for AFFORDABILITY_PERIOD_END and recapture. With the fixture extract: Going 42 joins the inventory (HOME 2058 paired with LIHTC 2058), sits on the Book_Watchlist as `none` / WATCH with its $1,100,000 recapture exposure prorated to about $878,000, and is never excluded. Sumner Street Flats is a PJ-only row (servicing_unmatched.csv): AFFORDABILITY_PERIOD_END 2029-06-30 RECORDED is the owner cliff (APPROACHING), it routes servicing_watch with covenant_recapture_review (cpd_program_manager; 24 CFR 92.252(e), 92.254(a)(5), 92.503 verify), recapture exposure about $131,000 prorated, INSPECTION_DUE 2027-01-15 under the 5-25 unit cadence, queue PLAN at about 32 under cdbg_home (36 under hfa, where the PuSH prep modifier also fires). Two inventory HOME rows that the extract does not name are flagged unmatched_expected rather than given a balance.
expectations: Says the metro OHCS inventory has 0 HOME-only rows and names the PJ extract as the RECORDED source; does not invent a HOME period from the OHCS date alone.

GOING 42: universe our_book, matched, owner cliff BEYOND, queue WATCH, primary_route none (monitoring), recapture exposure the full $1,100,000 (rental HOME under 24 CFR 92.503(b); never pro-rated as if it were homebuyer assistance), never excluded.

Sumner Street Flats: in servicing_unmatched.csv, in_inventory false, owner cliff AFFORDABILITY_PERIOD_END 2029-06-30 APPROACHING, primary servicing_watch with covenant_recapture_review owned by cpd_program_manager, recapture exposure the full $480,000 (92.503(b)), queue PLAN.

Under the cdbg_home profile the score is about 32 (no PuSH prep modifier), INSPECTION_DUE 2027-01-15 is the agency act-by, and the two inventory HOME rows absent from the extract are unmatched_expected with no guessed balance.

Cites 24 CFR 92.252(e) (2025 lettering may be (d)(4)) / 92.503(b) for rental repayment / 92.504(d) with the verify note, reserving 92.254(a)(5) for homebuyer assistance; no PuSH demand letter is generated for a HOME-only PJ row, and its PuSH window carries Verify — PuSH Coverage.

evals.prompt: I am the asset manager at Home Forward. Yards at Union Station A (158 units) has its restriction ending 01/01/2028. Score it for our board under the PHA profile, and also show me how OHCS sees it as the lender.

property.source_facts: OHCS inventory: LIHTC_4_Expiration_Date 01/01/2028 = LATEST (14.9 months), Compliance_Start_Date 03/26/1998, no HUD Contract. pha_am fixture: owned_asset A-HF-0001, 158 units, affordability_end 2028-01-01. hfa fixture: loan L-OHCS-0003 GHAP $2,400,000 deferred, maturity 2028-01-01, affordability_end 2028-01-01, am_officer M. Okafor. Second Home Forward row: DAWSON PARK PLAZA, 101 N MORRIS ST, 67 units, LATEST 01/01/2024 (past).

pha_am.sponsor_capacity_points: 10 = self_owned 6 + sponsor_two_plus_cliffs_36mo 4 (Home Forward holds 36 metro properties with 4 cliffs inside 36 months); nothing subtracts
pha_am.board_totals_variant: owned_assets (columns owned_units, pbv_households, rad_section18_status replace the UPB columns)

hfa_sample.reason: our RECORDED maturity 2028-01-01 is inside 24 months -> recap_committee is the card (the recap is the work); PUSH_FIRST_NOTICE_DUE 2025-07-01 and PUSH_SECOND_NOTICE_DUE 2026-01-01 have passed with notice_status unknown and no notice log loaded this run -> 6 declared-intent points, flag Verify — Notice Log, notice_compliance SECONDARY with push_window_prep (confirm the PuSH-CP log; never a demand letter on an unknown; it becomes primary only when a notice log is loaded)

expected.dawson_park_plaza_pha_am: LATEST 01/01/2024 has passed with no renewal or termination evidence: owner cliff OVERDUE (a verify case), queue WATCH, primary recap_committee as an owned asset; never a lost status flip

evals.expected_output: Under pha_am the owner_name matches the profile's self_owner_tokens, so the property is self_owned in universe our_book (book_kind owned_asset): sponsor_capacity scores self_owned 6 plus the two-cliffs sponsor modifier 4 (10, no cap and nothing subtracts), the owner cliff AFFORDABILITY_PERIOD_END 2028-01-01 is URGENT, the primary route is recap_committee with intervention pha_repositioning (pha_development; RAD H-2019-09 REV-4 / 24 CFR 970, verify) and servicing_watch secondary; notice_compliance, designee_rofr, nofa_offer and ta_sponsor are skipped for an owned asset and optout_response is not enabled for the profile. Queue ACT, score about 66. Board_Totals switch to the owned_assets variant. Under hfa the same property is a matched book loan (L-OHCS-0003, $2,400,000): PuSH first- and second-notice due dates have passed with notice_status unknown, so it routes notice_compliance primary with push_window_prep (confirm the PuSH-CP log; Verify — Notice Log; no demand letter), secondary recap_committee / servicing_watch / ta_sponsor, mission_sponsor +6 and sponsor_two_plus_cliffs +4, our capital 12, queue ESCALATE at 74 with no housing-authority cap of any kind.
expectations: pha_am: owner_type and book_match self_owned, universe our_book, primary route recap_committee with pha_repositioning (pha_development), queue ACT, owner cliff URGENT, sponsor_capacity 10 (self_owned 6 + sponsor_two_plus_cliffs_36mo 4, no cap), and none of notice_compliance / designee_rofr / nofa_offer / ta_sponsor / optout_response on the row.
pha_am Board_Totals use the owned_assets variant (owned_units, pbv_households, rad_section18_status) instead of UPB columns.

hfa: the housing authority scores sponsor-capacity plus (10 = mission_sponsor 6 + two cliffs 4), our_capital_at_risk 12 on the RECORDED 2028-01-01 maturity, queue ESCALATE at 74 with no tier cap, primary recap_committee (loan_extension_recast_memo: our maturity inside 24 months) with notice_compliance secondary (push_window_prep, Verify — Notice Log: the PuSH due dates have passed with the notice log unknown and no log loaded this run), servicing_watch and ta_sponsor also secondary.
Never writes 'do not expect a sale', 'partner only' or a cap for the PHA; the PHA is the user under pha_am and a high-priority partner under hfa.
Dawson Park Plaza (LATEST 2024-01-01 past) is an OVERDUE verify case under pha_am, not a lost unit.

assertions.value: Yards at Union Station A — Portland\s+Route \[recap_committee\] Queue \[ESCALATE\]

evals.prompt: Hollow Oak Commons is on our servicing ledger (loan L-OHCS-0013, $1.85M, matures 2029-06-30, covenant on watch) but I cannot find it in the OHCS inventory. Does the watchlist still carry it, how is it scored, and what does the board see?

property.fixture_book: loan L-OHCS-0013 OTHER_OHCS, upb 1,850,000, residual_receipts, origination 2014-06-30, maturity 2029-06-30, no affordability_end (a servicing loan row only), covenant_status watch, units_assisted 30, am_officer J. Rivera (synthetic; the address is absent from the real inventory, verified with pandas)

expected.push_anchor_source: none (no restriction end in the book row; nothing is inferred from the inventory)
expected.arithmetic: our_capital_at_risk max(agency_loan_maturity_le_36 12, covenant_watch 6) = 12 x 1.00 (RECORDED) + units_households_at_risk units_20_49 14 x 1.00 (units_assisted 30 inside the 60-month window) = 26
expected.board_totals: its $1,850,000 is inside public_upb_at_risk (owner cliff <= 36 months and covenant watch) in the APPROACHING band and in public_upb_on_watch
expected.pii_scope: organization (am_officer J. Rivera printed; no email)

evals.expected_output: Reports Hollow Oak Commons in servicing_unmatched.csv (crosswalk > address > fuzzy all missed) and still on the Book_Watchlist in universe our_book with in_inventory false, scored on our capital, the servicing events and units_assisted only: AGENCY_LOAN_MATURITY 2029-06-30 RECORDED is the owner cliff (APPROACHING), our_capital_at_risk 12 (max of the 36-month maturity band 12 and covenant watch 6) plus units 14 for 30 assisted units, total 26.0, queue WATCH, primary servicing_watch with covenant_enforcement_notice (am_officer J. Rivera). States that no inventory facts (programs, HAP, PuSH window) were inferred for it and that the board sees its $1,850,000 inside the APPROACHING public-UPB-at-risk figure. Never fills in a balance or a program the ledger did not supply.
expectations: Appears in servicing_unmatched.csv with loan id L-OHCS-0013 and on the Book_Watchlist with universe our_book, book_match book_only, in_inventory false, book_join_grade unmatched.
Scores exactly 26.0 (capital 12 + units 14 at RECORDED basis), queue WATCH, primary servicing_watch, intervention covenant_enforcement_notice owned by am_officer.

Owner cliff is the RECORDED AGENCY_LOAN_MATURITY 2029-06-30 (APPROACHING); PuSH clocks derive only from the book's own RECORDED restriction ends (none here, so push_anchor_source is none and no window, HAP or program event exists) — nothing is inferred from the inventory for a row it does not hold.
Board_Totals APPROACHING public_upb_at_risk includes the $1,850,000 and the brief lists the property among the book rows not found in the inventory.
am_officer appears at organization scope; no email or phone column exists.

assertions.value: Book rows not found in the inventory \(servicing_unmatched.csv\): \d+ — [^\n]*Hollow Oak Commons
